label: MARKETING TERM
headline: What's a KPI?
body: A Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is a measurable value that shows how effectively you are achieving a business objective.
caption:
For your online business, KPIs help you keep an eye on what really matters. Instead of just guessing, you can track specific numbers like how many new followers you get in a month, how many people sign up for your newsletter, or how many purchases happen from a specific product page.
